title: Elwynn Forest
body: Elwynn Forest is the green heartland of the kingdom of Stormwind, a country of tall hardwoods, rivers and rich farmland, with the capital in its northwestern hills. In the First War the Horde burned through these woods, destroyed Northshire Abbey and left the city in ruins, and the people came back only after the Second War. Now much of the Stormwind Army is fighting far away, and a thin line of marshals and volunteer deputies holds the forest against kobolds, gnolls, murlocs and red-masked thieves.

title: Northshire Abbey
body: Northshire Abbey was founded by clerics of the Holy Light who came south from Lordaeron. Orcs destroyed it in the First War, though refugees carried its sacred books out of the ruins, and in the Second War the ogre Cho'gall made it the headquarters of his Twilight's Hammer clan. Archbishop Alonsus Faol rebuilt it and gathered its priests and paladins into the Brotherhood of Northshire, and today it trains the realm's new defenders.

title: Goldshire
body: Goldshire is the largest town in Elwynn, a crossroads where the roads from the capital and Northshire meet those running on to Westfall and Redridge. Gnolls from Redridge once attacked it and were driven off by the Stormwind Army, and in the First War it was among the last towns to fall to the Horde. Rebuilt after the Second War, it is now Marshal Dughan's headquarters, and travelers gather at the Lion's Pride Inn.

title: The Stonefield Farm
body: The Stonefield Farm in southern Elwynn is home to a large and quarrelsome family, locked in a bitter feud with the Maclures, whose vineyards lie to the east beyond Fargodeep Mine. Their neighbors the Brackwells were less lucky: bandits took their pumpkin patch, no one knows what became of the family, and only their enormous prize sow remains, fattening herself on the Stonefields' crops.

title: Tower of Azora
body: East of Goldshire rises the Tower of Azora, seat of the high mage Theocritus. He and the warlock Morganth, who rules the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, are bitter rivals, and each spies on the other by magic. Theocritus built the Eye of Azora to watch his enemy, but seeing is not enough: he means to learn Morganth's plans, and has spent months trying to speak through the enchanted pendants the warlock uses to command his gnolls.

title: Heroes' Vigil
body: On the island in Stone Cairn Lake a ring of stones surrounds the Stone of Remembrance, raised for all who fell defending Stormwind, above all in the First War, when the orcs sacked Goldshire and the lands around it. Few come here now. Defias rogue wizards have taken the island, and two paladins who came seeking proof that the Brotherhood had crossed the kingdom's borders were quickly overwhelmed.

parts.body: Papers taken from the wizards lay out their plan: the forgotten monument is to become a Defias base camp, with reinforcements brought in from Westfall to stage the Brotherhood's attacks.

title: Marshal Dughan
body: Marshal Dughan commands the Stormwind Army in Goldshire and answers for the whole forest. It is a thankless post: with the army fighting far away he must make do with deputies and volunteers, while kobolds fill the mines, gnolls and thieves press in from the west and new troubles arrive faster than he can answer them. He is a cautious man who will not move his few soldiers on rumor alone.
notes: Rewritten 2026-10-25 for the reorganization pilot: shorter, context first.

title: Hogger
body: Hogger is the huge chieftain of the Riverpaw gnolls in southwestern Elwynn. Since the Third War the Riverpaw have raided farms across the forest, armed and guided, it is said, by the Defias Brotherhood, and Hogger has overpowered every attempt to capture him. The Stormwind Army offers a generous bounty for proof of his death.

parts.body: When his claw was laid before Marshal Dughan at last, the marshal laughed with relief: the beast had been giving him a headache the size of Blackrock Spire.
